description: This Java class 'FirmwareFlasher' provides a GUI for flashing firmware onto a device. It handles user interactions, executes external commands to flash firmware, and displays status messages.

classes.name: FirmwareFlasher
classes.description: A GUI component extending ProcessStatusWindow, responsible for flashing firmware onto a device via external tools, with user confirmation and status updates.

methods.name: FirmwareFlasher
methods.description: Constructor setting up GUI button and click action for firmware flashing.

methods.name: getOpenocdCommad
methods.description: Builds and returns the command string to invoke OpenOCD for flashing.

methods.name: doFlashFirmware
methods.description: Performs the firmware flashing process, checks for file existence, executes external command, and parses error output to update status.
